product.construction: Four-strand woven braid; US Dark Green specification set
product.quickSummary: J-Braid X4 is Daiwa's four-strand mainline. This guide uses the US Dark Green SKUs, keeping their 150-, 300-, and 3,000-yard packages distinct from the metric packages and rounded labels sold elsewhere. The X4 chart is not the same as the X8 or Grand X8 chart.
product.suitabilityTitle: Is J-Braid X4 right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Consider X4 when a four-carrier braid suits your setup and compare the exact diameter before choosing a spool. Carrier count describes construction; it does not certify abrasion performance in your conditions. Select strength around the tackle and cover, then use capacity to plan the amount.
strengthGuide: The verified 10 lb X4 is .007 inch / .17 mm. The old catalog entry of .006 inch must not be reused for this model merely because it matches a different J-Braid.
The US X4 20 lb and 15 lb rows both round to .008 inch, but their metric labels are .21 and .19 mm. At this display precision, equal inch labels do not mean identical physical diameters.

spoolingGuide.title: Read the package length

spoolingGuide.title: Prepare the spool attachment
spoolingGuide.text: Follow the reel maker's braid attachment instructions. Where a mono backing layer is used for grip, include it in the fill plan rather than treating the entire reel as empty.

spoolingGuide.title: Inspect after high load
spoolingGuide.text: Before casting again after a hard pull, check for buried or loose wraps and damaged working line. A four-strand label does not remove these basic line-management checks.

product.seoTitle: Seaguar Basix Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Compare verified Seaguar Basix diameters and package lengths. Estimate reel capacity, choose a working fill, and plan backing from exact specifications.
product.quickSummary: BasiX is Seaguar's value-positioned 100% fluorocarbon mainline. The current US assigned SKUs use 200-yard spools through 15 lb and a 175-yard spool at 20 lb. The option menu alone is not the package catalog: combinations without a real SKU are excluded from this guide.
product.suitabilityTitle: Is Basix right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Consider BasiX for a fluorocarbon working fill when package amount and diameter fit your reel. Price positioning does not establish the same handling as another Seaguar line. Compare the actual diameter, particularly before putting a heavier strength on a small spinning spool.
strengthGuide: The 10 lb BasiX entry is .011 inch / .285 mm, while 15 lb is .013 inch / .330 mm. The higher strength changes the fill calculation; it is not just a stronger label on the same line size.
The 20 lb entry is .016 inch / .405 mm and the assigned retail package is shorter at 175 yards. Both diameter and supplied amount change when moving up from 15 lb.
The 6 lb SKU is documented but withheld from this chart because its published .008 inch and .220 mm pair exceeds normal display-rounding tolerance.

spoolingGuide.title: Buy the assigned package
spoolingGuide.text: Use 200 yards for the verified 4, 8, 10, 12, and 15 lb SKUs, and 175 yards for 20 lb. The source also generates empty-SKU combinations; those are not offered here.

spoolingGuide.title: Set the working length first
spoolingGuide.text: A partial fluorocarbon fill over backing can conserve supply, but leave enough working line for casts, runs, and repeated reties. Stop at the reel's recommended fill level.

spoolingGuide.title: Distinguish mainline from a leader
spoolingGuide.text: BasiX can be cut for terminal use, but a short piece on braid is not the reel's working fill. Calculate the actual braid when that is what occupies the spool.

faqs.question: Is BasiX fluorocarbon-coated nylon?

product.metaDescription: Compare verified Sunline BMS Azayaka NY diameters and package lengths. Estimate reel capacity, choose a working fill, and plan backing from exact specifications.
product.construction: Nylon monofilament; two-meter Bite Marker System
product.quickSummary: Shooter BMS Azayaka NY is the nylon member of Sunline's marked-line family. The current Japanese product uses a silk-white base with yellow-green, orange, and black markings in a two-meter cycle. Its 80-meter package is about 87.49 yards, not 80 yards and not the FC model's bulk option.
product.suitabilityTitle: Is BMS Azayaka NY right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Consider this line when watching a marked nylon mainline is part of your reaction-bait or topwater presentation. The visibility system is a product feature; it cannot guarantee bite detection. Plan the relatively short package against casting distance and future trimming before deciding on backing.
strengthGuide: The product-specific 5 lb entry is .190 mm. Do not replace it with .185 mm from a generic size chart: the exact NY product table is the evidence here.
At 10 lb the standard diameter is .260 mm; 20 lb is .370 mm. The package remains 80 meters as strength rises, but reel capacity does not.
NY means nylon. BMS Azayaka FC is fluorocarbon with a different marking cycle and package range; sharing a family name does not make its data interchangeable.

spoolingGuide.title: Budget the 80 meters
spoolingGuide.text: A complete package provides about 87.49 yards before losses to knots and trimming. A long cast can consume a substantial part of that amount; check your required reserve first.

spoolingGuide.title: Use markings with context
spoolingGuide.text: The repeating two-meter color system aids observation. It is not a calibrated measurement of remaining spool capacity after pieces have been removed.

spoolingGuide.title: Keep the right suffix
spoolingGuide.text: Check NY on the package before winding. The FC product is a separate fluorocarbon, not another color of this nylon line.

faqs.question: Can I select the 320-meter FC bulk spool for NY?
faqs.answer: No. The verified NY product lists an 80-meter package. The FC model's bulk size is not evidence for NY.

faqs.question: Are the pound labels breaking-strength guarantees?
faqs.answer: Sunline labels the values as reference strength in the Japanese product table. Actual results depend on conditions and knots.

faqs.question: Where do the inch values come from?
faqs.answer: They are explicit conversions of Sunline's product-specific standard millimeter diameters. They are not separately measured or published inch values.

product.seoTitle: Seaguar JDM Grand Max Leader Diameter & Strength | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Compare verified Seaguar JDM Grand Max Leader diameters, strength labels and leader spool lengths. Select terminal material with exact manufacturer evidence.
product.quickSummary: Grand Max is a leader/tippet product in Seaguar's US JDM collection. It uses two fluorocarbon resins and comes on connectable, pocket-thin 60-meter spools. The unusual strengths, including 17, 19, 24, and 27 lb, are actual US variant labels, not rounded conventional strengths.
product.suitabilityTitle: Is JDM Grand Max Leader right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Grand Max suits a terminal leader or tippet choice when its exact diameter and knot behavior meet your rig requirements. Its thin, connectable spools organize a range of sizes without treating each package as a reel fill. Compare the metric diameter as well as the US pound label before choosing the next size.
strengthGuide: Choose the leader for the terminal connection, cover, lure, and knot requirements. The leader's pound-test label does not determine how much braid fits on the reel.
The US 8 lb and 10 lb labels both round to .009 inch, but their published metric diameters are .220 and .235 mm. Keep that difference visible when selecting leader size.
UK Grand Max tippet uses different strength labels and package lengths. Do not merge it with this US-import JDM collection.

spoolingGuide.title: Treat 60 meters as leader supply
spoolingGuide.text: Choose an individual leader length for your rig, allowing material for knots and replacement. Do not use the whole 60-meter package as a default leader or as a mainline fill recommendation.

spoolingGuide.title: Keep nearby labels distinct
spoolingGuide.text: Label each spool by the actual test and diameter. The 17, 19, 24 and 27 lb options are not interchangeable with conventional 15, 20, 25 or 30 lb labels.

spoolingGuide.title: Protect the remaining material
spoolingGuide.text: Keep the free end controlled on the compact spool and separate damaged material from the unused supply. Check the terminal section and connection after abrasion or a hard pull.

faqs.question: Should Grand Max fill the reel?
faqs.answer: This product is documented as leader/tippet material. Calculate the working spool with the actual main line, then select Grand Max for the terminal section.

faqs.question: Can 19 lb be renamed 20 lb?
faqs.answer: No. 19 lb is the exact published US variant label, SKU 19GM66. A nearby familiar pound test is a different identity.

faqs.question: Is 66 yards a second package?
faqs.answer: No. Seaguar describes one 60-meter package and rounds that amount to 66 yards. The exact metric conversion shown here is approximately 65.62 yards.
